evidence: Source property holds in all five dimension prompts. Each opens with 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright' (task/tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1) and each also says 'Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes.' Every judge.toml wires the playwright MCP server (command playwright-mcp, --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium), byte-identical to the template header. Functional adds only the verifier restart_mcp.py server for restart_app (functional/judge.toml:14-18), and the prompt limits it to 'only if your criterion says so, and then only once' (functional/prompt.md:1). The verifier image pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and Chromium (tests/Dockerfile:19,33-38), identical to the template Dockerfile. Nothing can be satisfied by first paint or memory. Both gates require a real sign-in with an invalid-password control (render) and a UI add-candidate plus reload plus independent-context Observer readback (constraints/judge.toml:25). Functional, polish and visual each restate an in-dimension gate with the same UI write, reload and independent-context readback, and 'A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails this check' (functional/prompt.md:15, polish/prompt.md:11, visual/prompt.md:11). Functional, polish and visual carry 'Report every step ... A step you skipped or did differently fails that criterion; never assume that an unobserved step would have passed' (functional:31-33, polish:20-22, visual:16-18). Every prompt says that an evaluator/tool failure scores binary0 or Likert1 as NOT EXERCISED, never as a guessed pass. Every prompt carries the checker-not-fixer 'Grading only' block (Colderwater lesson 6). Every functional, polish and visual criterion is a browser action/readback recipe: UI actions, independent contexts, page.evaluate DOM/activeElement/scroll reads, and replays limited to requests 'the UI was seen to use' via page.evaluate fetch or context request (functional:25). Visual requires the gate setup plus read-only review of five named live views, including an independent Noor context (visual:14), so Likert rows cannot be scored from a first screenshot. Colderwater lesson 13 (row 25 portal flag, public internet address): a grep for http(s) URLs across task/tests, instruction.md and environment/instructions finds only http://localhost:3000 (five prompts plus app_context.md:4) and http://127.0.0.1:3000 in test.sh:48,136. No public or outside address appears, and grading never depends on an outside site. The '@hireops.example' and '@candidates.example' strings are account emails, not addresses the judge visits. Conforming alternative: an app with other routes, labels, websocket or SSE transport, or a non-drag UI is accommodated by 'Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names' (all prompts) and app_context.md:37-38. Its port is fixed public at 3000 (instruction.md:15), so a conforming app cannot be missed by the URL. Weak app: a static shell, a first-paint mock or a localStorage-only save fails the in-dimension gate because the independent context sees no card. Minor observation, not a defect for this row: the two gate prompts lack the explicit 'Report every step / skipped step fails' paragraph that the scored prompts carry (Colderwater lesson 9). The impact is bounded because every scored dimension re-runs the same gate under that rule and zeroes on failure. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json states that no configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score exists; its 8 artifacts are scripted golden Playwright/API observations (hashes re-verified). Nothing measured shows the configured claude-code judge actually using the browser tools as prompted, including the browser_run_code_unsafe tool name in @playwright/mcp 0.0.79, which this snapshot does not demonstrate (other workspace tasks use the same name). Risk therefore stays true.
